title: (No AI) Tim Cook hints at iCloud Plus tier for AI power users
author: Emma Roth
content:
![A photo of Tim Cook](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/gettyimages-2280563832.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Apple may allow users to pay to increase their AI usage limits. During an earnings call on Thursday, Apple CEO Tim Cook said that he believes people will want to use Apple Intelligence and the upcoming Siri AI "a lot," adding that "we will have some kind of upgrade possibilities on iCloud Plus where people can buy up the stack."

This fall, Apple will broadly launch its [long-delayed Siri AI](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964714/siri-ai-public-beta-preview-ios-27-hands-on) with iOS 27, which can do things like answer questions about what's on your screen and take action across your apps. It also includes a new standalone Siri AI app that offers a ChatGPT-like interface.

In June, [Apple said that its AI features](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/06/09/icloud-subscribers-get-higher-apple-intelligence-usage-limits/?link_source=ta_first_comment&taid=6a28101657887c0001f3feb1&utm_campaign=trueanthem&utm_medium=social&utm_source=facebook), including …

title: (No AI) The loss of Situational Awareness
author: Elizabeth Lopatto
content:
![A brain surrounded by blue lines as though it’s connected to things ooooo](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/STKS522_AGI_B.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Neither artificial nor intelligent.

I am not by any means an expert at finance but I think I do now have some advice for people who are: Do not name your hedge fund anything that will be hilarious if it blows up. Don't use a name like "[Long-Term Capital Management](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long-Term_Capital_Management)" or "[Amaranth Advisors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amaranth_Advisors)" (named for the floral symbol for immortality). Certainly do not call yourself "Situational Awareness," which might as well just be "Hubris, Inc."

Anyway, Situational Awareness, the hedge fund started by a 24-year-old former OpenAI employee that focuses on artificial intelligence bets, has sold [most](https://www.reuters.com/technology/citadel-buys-most-situationals-stock-holdings-after-ai-share-rout-sources-say-2026-07-30/) or [all](https://www.axios.com/2026/07/30/ai-hedge-fund-situational-awareness-citadel), [depending](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-30/situational-awareness-assets-fall-to-10-billion-after-losses) on [who's](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/leopold-aschenbrenners-hedge-fund-is-facing-steep-ai-losses.html) [reporting](https://www.wsj.com/finance/citadel-buys-situational-awarenesss-stock-portfolio-after-big-losses-in-ai-5117159b?mod=hp_lead_pos3), of its entire public stock portfolio to [Ken Griffin](https://fortune.com/2026/03/31/ken-griffin-citadel-securities-hedge-fund-miami-wall-street-trump-republican-politics/?utm_source=sfmc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=NL_fortune-features_2026-3-31_108268&utm_term=fortune-features&sfmc_id=14949166)'s Cit …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/973467/ai-bet-situational-awareness-oops-stonks)
